## Context

Eight artboards, the shell they share, and the four choices that are genuinely open. Published because milestone 2c built one surface in code without one, which is what the brief's own rule exists to prevent.

## Depends on

Nothing. It is a design, and it blocks the surfaces rather than the other way round.

## Discharges

The rule in docs/ui-surfaces.md that layout reaches the owner as a published visual plan.

## Plan

[plan-4827b50a72674a22](https://plan.agent-native.com/plans/plan-4827b50a72674a22)

## Done means

Every surface named in docs/ui-surfaces.md has an artboard, including the one already built.
The already-built surface appears as the baseline to argue with rather than as a design that was chosen.
Every open question the brief names is either answered in the plan or in its Open Questions form, with a recommendation.
No number in the plan is unmeasured: the loopback figures are labelled as loopback, and the record counts match the store.
No further surface is built before the plan is answered.

## Risks

A plan is not a design review. If it is approved without being read, it launders the same failure it was written to correct.
The four open questions decide surfaces that arrive at milestones 3 through 6. Answering them now means answering them with less information than the milestone will have, and the plan says which are cheap to revisit.
